Treatment Services

At Garden Springs Wellness Center in Englewood, New Jersey, we understand the overwhelming impact mental health conditions can have. We stand committed to offering personalized, evidence-based care that fosters hope and transformation for our clients.
Mental illness is a profound challenge affecting many individuals and their families. It can manifest in various forms, including depression, anxiety, trauma, and other psychological disorders.

At Garden Springs Wellness Center, we offer effective and comprehensive mental health treatment programs tailored to meet the unique needs of each individual. Our team combines compassionate care with clinical expertise, utilizing evidence-based therapies to empower our clients on their journey towards mental wellness.

Types of Mental Health Treatment We Offer in NJ

Treatment at Garden Springs encompasses a multifaceted approach. We recognize that mental health care needs to be consistent and continuous to be effective. Our treatment process includes assessment, diagnosis, and a personalized therapeutic plan.
At Garden Springs, we offer multiple levels of care to accommodate the varying needs of our clients. These include:

This intensive level of care provides a structured environment where clients live on-site and receive round-the-clock support. It is ideal for individuals with severe mental health conditions that require constant supervision and a secure, supportive setting.

blocks.text: The Benefits of Choosing Our Mental Health Rehab in NJ

Choosing to attend Garden Springs Wellness Center means opting for high-quality mental health care characterized by our state-of-the-art facilities and a dedicated team of professionals. Here are the key benefits of our programs:
We prioritize individualized care plans tailored to each client’s unique needs, ensuring a thorough and effective treatment journey.

Our team comprises licensed therapists, psychiatrists, and mental health professionals with extensive experience in treating various mental health conditions. Their expertise ensures that clients receive the best possible care.
We utilize therapeutic approaches that are scientifically proven to be effective, including cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), dialectical behavior therapy (DBT), mindfulness, and more.

Our center provides a nurturing and supportive environment where clients can feel safe and understood. We believe that a positive therapeutic relationship is fundamental to successful treatment outcomes.

We aim to equip clients with the tools and strategies needed for sustained mental wellness, promoting long-term recovery beyond their time at the center. To schedule a tour or learn more about the Garden Springs Wellness Center admissions process, contact us today.

blocks.text: Your first visit to Garden Springs Wellness Center will include a comprehensive assessment by one of our licensed professionals. We will discuss your mental health history, current symptoms, and overall wellness goals. This initial session helps us design a personalized treatment plan tailored to your specific needs, ensuring you receive the best possible care.

The length of our treatment programs can vary based on individual needs and progress. Our partial day treatment programs often run for several weeks, with clients attending multiple sessions per week. Throughout your treatment, we will regularly assess your progress and make any necessary adjustments to your plan, ensuring it continues to meet your evolving needs.

We offer a variety of evidence-based therapies at Garden Springs Wellness Center, including Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT), Dialectical Behavioral Therapy (DBT), mindfulness practices, and holistic therapies such as yoga and art therapy. Our multidisciplinary approach ensures a well-rounded treatment experience that addresses both your mental and emotional health.

We are committed to making mental health care accessible and offer several payment options. We accept a wide range of private PPO insurance plans and will work directly with your insurer to maximize your benefits. For those without insurance or who prefer not to use it, we offer flexible private pay arrangements. Our team is here to help guide you through the financial process, ensuring you can focus on your healing journey.

Your journey towards mental wellness is important, and Garden Springs Wellness Center is here to walk alongside you every step of the way. We invite you to take the first step in seeking help for mental health and dual-diagnosis conditions.

At Garden Springs Wellness Center, we offer personalized solutions and a transformative experience designed to restore balance, hope, and happiness in your life. Our team is committed to guiding you through every challenge, offering the support and expertise required to achieve mental well-being.
